summary: The first launch did not start because shell redirection targeted a log file under a parent directory that had not yet been created.
evidence: The command exited before the Python entry point with `No such file or directory` for outputs/video-action-labeling/...-output.tmp.
No experiment directory or model artifact was created by the failed launch.
lessons: Outer launcher log parents must be created before redirection; experiment-owned directories cannot be relied on before the entry point starts.
limitations: This attempt produced no scientific result.
next_actions: Create the outer log parent explicitly and retry in a new immutable experiment directory.
